name: get-resq-software
description: Pinned, hash-verified distribution Worker for get.resq.software
//: devDependencies only, deliberately. This Worker ships zero runtime
dependencies: the deployed bundle is src/index.ts and nothing else, so
no third-party code reaches the endpoint that serves install scripts.
Versions are exact, not ranged. A caret here would mean the toolchain
that produces the bytes users pipe into a shell could change without a
reviewed commit, which is the same property PINS exists to deny.
Deploys are performed by Cloudflare Workers Builds from main using its
own wrangler; these pins keep local builds and CI typechecking against
known versions rather than whatever npm resolves that day.
Biome is pinned to 2.5.2 to match resq-software/npm, the org's TypeScript
repo, so this repo reports the same findings rather than a nearby dialect.
It runs on Biome's own defaults with no biome.json, which is deliberate:
the org config's formatter strips the quotes from the generated PINS keys
that bin/gen-pins.sh writes back on every --write, and the two would then
disagree permanently. Defaults lint clean, so no config is needed to earn
//overrides: miniflare, reached through wrangler, pins sharp and undici to versions
that have since picked up advisories (GHSA-wq5f-xc86-pv6w for sharp;
GHSA-2m5v-pch6-74hx and seven more for undici). Upstream has not moved,
and osv-scanner reads this lockfile, so the finding stands until it is
Neither package ships. The deployed bundle is src/index.ts and nothing
else; both arrive only through the local dev server.
Each is the lowest published version that clears its advisory, which is
not the same size of jump in both cases: sharp 0.35.4 -> 0.35.5 is a
patch, undici 7.29.1 -> 7.30.1 crosses a minor. miniflare asks for
undici 7.29.0, so the override is already ahead of what it pins and this
widens that gap by one minor -- worth a look if the dev server starts
behaving oddly, though undici is semver-minor here, not breaking.
Raise each one again when the next advisory lands, or drop it once
miniflare pins at or above it on its own.
